notes.title: Update 0.47
notes.notes:
[b]Update 08.05.2025[/b]

- Added a menu scene instead of a black screen.
- Progress saving now only disappears after fully losing rune stones, not upon character death.
- Added difficulty selection.
- Easy:
enemies deal less damage.
- Hard:
enemies have more health.
enemies deal more damage.
- Extreme:
enemies have more health.
enemies deal more damage.
enemies are not knocked back by your attacks.
- Minor sound changes.

notes.title: Update 0.44
notes.notes:
[b]Update 24.04.2025[/b]

- Added progress saving, but upon character death or losing, you lose it.
- Heavy attack has been changed, both in animation and functionality.
- The "Blow from above" skill no longer replaces the heavy attack but is now activated by its own input combo.
- Added a new skill: "Pierced blow".
- Added two new alchemy items:
  "Cassette Trap"
  "Ballista"
- Added a "Combat Tools" tab in the interface for constructions.
- Minor adjustments to some sound effects.

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Update 12.04.2025[/b]

- Enemies' health was reduced, but the maximum damage value was increased.
- The Bear Spirit skill has been reworked and is now passive.
- Additionally, two new passive skills have been added:
  "Lust for battle"
  "Life Drain"
- Changes to the main interface.
- Some icons have been updated.
- The forge has been modified and simplified.
- The upgrade cost in the forge has also been reduced from 10/15 to 5.

notes.title: Update 0.32
notes.notes:
[b]Update 31.03.2025[/b]

- The sword has become larger.
- The attack radius has increased.
- Basic attacks have been changed.
- Some animations have been changed.
- Added a hit stagger animation for enemies, combat will now be slightly easier.
- Enemy attacks are now scaled by their level, for example: Level 1 - 4 attacks, Level 2 - 6 attacks, Level 3 - 8 attacks.
- Enemies can now drop alchemical items as loot.

notes.title: Update 0.28
notes.notes:
[b]Update 15.03.2025[/b]

- A new elite enemy, the "Troll," has been added and starts appearing after the 5th wave.
- It now has a new type of attack called "Unblockable" in its arsenal.
- A "Dodge roll" has been added to evade both regular and unblockable attacks.
- A "Heavy attack" has been introduced.
- A new skill has been added to the library "Blow from above", to enhance the heavy attack.
- Hit effects on enemies have been added.
- Blood now also appears on the ground.
- A blood effect on the screen has been added when health is low.
- Minor changes have been made to the interfaces.
- The condition for using skills has been changed; instead of mana and stamina, rune power is now used, with indicators located above the health bar.
- Mana and stamina potions have been removed and replaced with a rune elixir.
- Sounds and animations have been slightly improved or reworked.
- An introductory animation has also been added at the start of the game.

notes.title: Update 0.21
notes.notes:
[b]Update 25.02.2025[/b]

- Added training for activity locations inside the castle.
- Improved registration of hits on the enemy.
- Minor changes to the interface.
- Minor changes in enemy damage.
- Added extra health potion at start.
- loot FX improvement.
